name: praxis-public-web
description: Praxis LS public web — the stranger-facing React 18 + Vite + TS app: the tenant marketing site (/public/*) and the external portal (/portal/*). Standalone app, sibling to client/ and platform-console/.
//why: A third app rather than more routes in client/, because the audience is different and so is the payload: a visitor from a search engine must not download the ERP's shell, its Radix kit, its editor or its fifteen fonts. Same toolchain as client/ and platform-console/ on purpose — one way of building a Vite app in this repo, three surfaces.
//engines: Mirrors the root package.json and .nvmrc, for the reason stated in client/package.json: an undeclared engine range lets a dev tree on a newer Node accept a dependency CI cannot run.
//fontkit: A devDependency used ONLY by scripts/font-metrics.cjs and never imported by the app — `check:fonts-fallback` opens the real .woff2 files to derive the metric-matched overrides. Declared HERE rather than leant on from the repo root, because the root is not there: the public-web CI job runs `npm ci --prefix public-web` and the root install step is gated on matrix.app == 'client'. fontkit reaches the root only transitively via pdfkit, which is not a thing to depend on in either place.

scripts.//check:palette: The ONE copy lives in client/scripts. A second copy of a gate is a gate that drifts — the same reason client/eslint-local-rules is re-exported rather than duplicated.
scripts.//check:contrast: Same single-copy rule as check:palette. Ported here in PR 4 (guide O-9/F-14) — it is the gate that computes F-15, and it found three more live AA failures the moment it was pointed at this app.
scripts.//check:fonts-fallback: Metric-matched fallbacks are derived from the real .woff2 files. A @fontsource bump moves them, and a stale file is a reflow nobody sees in review.
